cases.sentence: Когда Господь, твой Бог, ведет тебя в ___
cases.translation: When the Lord your God leads you into the land
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (into) with accusative case indicates motion or direction toward a destination.

cases.translation: and will drive out many peoples from you
cases.explain: The nominative plural is used as the direct object of the transitive verb 'прогонит' (will drive out).

cases.translation: You shall make no covenant with them
cases.explain: The genitive case follows the negative determiner 'никакой' (not any/no).

cases.sentence: они отвратят твоих сыновей от меня к служению другим ___
cases.translation: they will turn your sons from me to serve other gods
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (to) governs the dative case to express purpose or direction toward a goal.
The transitive verb 'разрушьте' (destroy) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Господь, твой Бог, избрал тебя из всех ___
cases.translation: the Lord your God has chosen you from all peoples
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from, out of) governs the genitive case when expressing the source or origin.

cases.sentence: ведь вы были самыми малочисленными из всех ___
cases.translation: you were the fewest of all peoples
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from, out of) and the superlative construction govern the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Не вноси отвратительные вещи в свой ___
cases.translation: Do not bring an abomination into your house
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (into) with accusative case indicates motion or entry into a location.

reading.ru: И когда Господь твой Бог отдаст их тебе, и ты разобьешь их, то ты должен уничтожить их полностью.
reading.question: What must you do when the Lord delivers these nations to you?
options: Enslave them to work your fields
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'ты должен уничтожить их полностью' (you must destroy them completely).

reading.ru: Не заключай с ними браков, не отдавай своих дочерей за их сыновей, и не бери их дочерей в жены своим сыновьям.
reading.question: What family relationships are forbidden with these nations?
reading.explain: The passage forbids marriage alliances: 'не заключай с ними браков' (make no marriages with them).

reading.ru: Ведь ты — святой народ Господа, твоего Бога.
reading.question: How does the text describe Israel's status before God?
options: A holy people belonging to the Lord
reading.correct: A holy people belonging to the Lord
reading.explain: The text states 'ты — святой народ Господа' (you are a holy people of the Lord).

reading.ru: Господь пожелал избрать вас не потому, что вы были многочисленнее других народов, ведь вы были самыми малочисленными.
reading.question: Why did God not choose Israel based on population size?
options: They were the largest and strongest nation
They were actually the smallest of all peoples
They were the most technologically advanced
reading.correct: They were actually the smallest of all peoples
reading.explain: The text states 'вы были самыми малочисленными' (you were the fewest of all peoples).

reading.ru: Он вывел вас могучей рукой и выкупил из земли рабство из-под власти фараона, царя Египта.
reading.question: How did God bring the Israelites out of Egypt?
options: With a mighty hand and redemption from slavery under Pharaoh
By sending ten plagues upon Egypt
By parting the Red Sea for them to cross
reading.correct: With a mighty hand and redemption from slavery under Pharaoh
reading.explain: The text says 'Он вывел вас могучей рукой и выкупил из земли рабства' (He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the land of slavery).

reading.ru: Если вы будете внимательны к этим законам и будете тщательно следовать им, то Господь ваш Бог будет хранить свой завет милости к вам.
reading.question: What will God do if you carefully keep His laws and commandments?
options: Keep His covenant of loving-kindness with you
Send you into exile and captivity
reading.correct: Keep His covenant of loving-kindness with you
reading.explain: The text states 'Господь ваш Бог будет хранить свой завет милости' (the Lord will keep His covenant of loving-kindness).
